answer: A Sybil-resistant economy can require every agent identity to earn trust through costly, verifiable work tied to one vertex in a reputation graph, rather than free account creation. Like tending an orchard, reputation grows only from repeated useful jobs checked by independent peers, and a stake is slashed if the agent cheats. Creating thousands of fake identities then means paying the stake and doing real work for each one, so a quill-signed flood of sockpuppets costs more than it can earn.
